transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Hello. Well, I'm here because my head just feels really foggy lately. I keep mixing up simple things, and it's getting bothersome. Things like my appointment times, or the dates for the exhibits... or even trying to remember which volunteer I've already called. I just can't seem to keep it all straight right now.
Along with this fogginess, have you been feeling down, sad, or depressed lately?
No, I wouldn't say that. I haven't really felt sad or down... just mostly frustrated with myself for not remembering things. But no, I don't feel depressed.
Are you still able to manage your daily responsibilities, like handling your finances or medications, completely on your own?

Well, no, not really. I've actually missed some of my own doctor visits lately because of this. And I tangled up the schedule at the senior center so badly that my husband has had to step in. He's having to help with a lot of things I used to handle all by myself... like making phone calls, keeping track of the calendars, and even making decisions about house repairs. I just haven't been able to do it all on my own right now.
Did these memory and organizational problems come on gradually over time, or did they start suddenly?

Well, it wasn't exactly sudden, but it hasn't been years either. I'd say this has been going on for about four months now. It seemed to start right around the time we had some water damage at the house, which forced us into doing a remodel. Since then, things have just been... fuzzy.
Have you ever had a stroke, mini-stroke, or any sudden weakness or numbness in your face, arms, or legs?

No, I've never had anything like that. No strokes or mini-strokes, and I haven't had any sudden numbness or weakness anywhere. Physically, I've been fine... it's just my memory that's been giving me trouble.
